display.purpose: Region names, in sun on dark ground and ink on haze-hi or sand; the footer wordmark.

display-hero.purpose: The artist name set edge to edge across the first viewport.

headline-row.purpose: Channel names in the shore list.

meta.purpose: Dates, durations, track numbers; tabular numerals.

shadows.name: player-hang-hero
shadows.purpose: Hero player frame on pale sky.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All lifts and moves: buttons and badges 300ms, player art scale and dim 500ms, channel arrow 300ms.

motion.name: color-state
motion.purpose: Row hover tints and color changes.

motion.name: ground-shift
motion.purpose: Body --ground color mixed from the region at the viewport midline on scroll (rAF-throttled); off with reduced motion or without JS, where stepped bands show.

motion.name: sunset
motion.purpose: Sun and glow drop through the dusk band; static half-set without scroll-timeline support or with reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations under prefers-reduced-motion; smooth scrolling off.

narrative.overview:
The whole site is one sky that the visitor descends through. The ground is not a background color behind content; it is the place. It starts as the hazy cerulean of CRISTIAN's own photographs at midday, deepens through a dusk band with a thin apricot horizon and a setting sun, goes to night indigo, and lands on the teal of the Caribbean at Santa Marta, closed by a strip of sand. Every region owns its color field edge to edge; nothing floats on a neutral page.

Against that sky, one voice: Exuberante highlighter yellow, set in heavy, expanded, uppercase Archivo. It names each region and marks the one action that matters (play). Body text is Archivo at normal width, white on the dark regions and ink on the pale haze. Media sits in hard-edged dark frames that open into the YouTube player in place; nothing becomes a card, nothing gets rounded.

Density is low and the type is large. Lists are ruled, not boxed: the tracklist and the channel list are thick-topped, hairline-divided rows whose whole width is the hit target.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous ground that changes with scroll (sky, dusk, night, sea), with fixed stepped bands as the no-JS and reduced-motion fallback.
Sun yellow is the only accent: display type, the primary play action, the playing state.
Archivo variable carries everything; the width axis does the hierarchy work (125 display, 112-122 heads, 100 body).
Square corners everywhere except the literal sun.
Media opens in place; one track plays at a time.

rules.name: The One Sun Rule
rules.body: Sun yellow is the only accent color. If something needs emphasis and is not a display headline, the primary play action, or a state (playing, hover, focus, selection), it does not get yellow.

rules.name: The Ground Is Place Rule
rules.body: Every section declares a ground color from the sky ramp (as `data-ground`, either one color or `from>to`), and the page interpolates between them. Never add a section with an off-ramp background or a neutral gray panel.

rules.name: The Ink On Light Rule
rules.body: On haze-hi, sand, yellow and white, text and focus rings switch to ink (the region carries `on-light`). Everywhere else, text is white and focus is yellow.

rules.name: The Width Is Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Rank comes from the width axis together with weight: 125 for display, 112-122 for heads and actions, 100 for reading text. Do not bring in a second family to make contrast.

rules.name: The Uppercase Is Loud Rule
rules.body: Uppercase belongs to display, headlines, the channel rows and action labels. Body, quotes, track titles and meta stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The Hanging Frame Rule
rules.body: Shadows are always soft, tinted, and pulled in by a negative spread, and they go only under media frames and play actions. Rows, text and sections never get one.

dos: **Do** give every new region a ground color from the sky ramp and declare it with `data-ground`, keeping the fixed band as its own background for the fallback.
**Do** set every region name in the display style: Archivo 900, wdth 125, uppercase, in sun on dark ground and ink on haze-hi or sand.
**Do** let media open in place through the Player facade, keeping one active player at a time and `aria-pressed` on rows that drive a shared player.
**Do** build lists as ruled rows (2px top rule, 1px dividers at 25-35%) whose full width is the hit target.
**Do** switch text and focus to ink on pale regions by marking them `on-light`.
**Do** honor reduced motion: no ground interpolation, no sunset travel, near-instant transitions.
donts: **Don't** put content in cards, rounded containers or neutral gray panels; color fields own whole regions.
**Don't** use gradients as decoration on buttons, text or frames. Gradients exist only to paint the sky, the sunset, the sea and the photo masks.
**Don't** introduce a second accent. Ember belongs to the horizon only, and white is a surface only for the subscribe button and the secondary badge.
**Don't** round corners on interface elements; the sun is the only circle.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows, or any shadow outside media frames and play actions.
**Don't** add a label above section headings; the display headline names the region alone.
